noun_definition: mweb refers to the mobile web version of the Expensify application, where users can perform tasks such as creating and deleting tasks within group chats.
Task refers to a specific assignment created within a group chat on the staging.new.expensify.com website that can be deleted by the user.

Back button refers to the arrow on the top left corner of the chat interface that allows the user to navigate back to the previous screen, specifically to the LHN (Left Hand Navigation) after deleting a task.
User refers to an individual interacting with the staging.new.expensify.com website who is expected to be redirected to the LHN after deleting a task and pressing the back button.
lhn refers to the Left Hand Navigation, which is the interface element that the user expects to be redirected to after deleting a task and tapping the back button in the chat.
